step1_analysis.circuit_type: Differential pair with tail current source (Active Core)
step1_analysis.description: This is the active transistor core of an RF circuit (likely a mixer, amplifier, or oscillator), where the passive components (stacked inductors/transformers mentioned in the paper) were connected to the drains but omitted in this extraction. With one input grounded, it effectively operates as a single-ended amplifier with source degeneration.

paper_reference.title: Stacked Inductors and Transformers in CMOS Technology

tail_current.description: DC current provided by the tail current source (XM3)

sky130_expected.calculation: XM3 operates in the linear region due to the low common-source voltage. Id = unCox * W/L * (Vgs - Vth - Vds/2) * Vds. With Vgs=0.9V, Vth=0.42V, solving for Vds (V_N0) yields ~0.14V and Id ~156uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on SKY130 NMOS parameters and 0.9V bias.

v_n0_dc.description: DC voltage at the common source node

sky130_expected.calculation: Equating Id2 and Id3 gives V(N0) ~ 0.14V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determines the operating region of the tail current source.

ac_gain.description: AC voltage gain from LABEL_NET_0 to N2

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = -gm2 * R2 / (1 + gm2/gds3). gm2 ~ 917uS, gds3 ~ 918uS, R2 = 1k. Gain ~ -0.46 V/V or -6.7 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low gain due to source degeneration from the linear-region tail transistor and the absence of the high-Q inductor load.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, tail current, AC gain, and transient response of the extracted differential pair core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for extracted differential pair
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 GND N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Sources and Loads (Resistors added to replace missing inductors)
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
R1 VDD N1 1k
R2 VDD N2 1k

* Bias and Input
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 sin(0.9 0.1 1Meg)

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
op
let id_tail = -i(VVDD)
let v_n2 = v(N2)
let v_n0 = v(N0)
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print id_tail v_n2 v_n0 power

ac dec 10 1k 1G
let gain_db = vdb(N2)
meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=1Meg

tran 10n 5u
meas tran v_max max v(N2)
meas tran v_min min v(N2)
quit
.endc
.end
